statements.statement: The denial reason code is CO-197
The patient has recurrent presyncope and fatigue
The recurrent presyncope and fatigue are attributed to symptomatic bradycardia
The patient has a diagnosis of sick sinus syndrome (I49.5)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
The monitoring is to evaluate for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias
The arrhythmias may contribute to thromboembolic risk
